overview: At the sacks you wrote the three proverbs under Prices. You wrote that you bought nothing, that the penny loaf is still a penny and shrunk on the pan, and that you did not measure it. You wrote the Star Chamber talk as talk you do not know.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the page at the sacks and stopped.

assets.name: the penny loaf
assets.disposition: Wrote under Prices in the commonplace book
